info.name: Kriraghor API: M24 · The desk through a lost connection
info.description:
M24 §22 (product owner, 11 Nov 2026): while online the front desk keeps a copy of the members (and, with fees.collect, the open dues), stamped and signed by the server. Without a connection it checks members in and takes cash with a temporary slip; each item waits on the device and is sent once when the connection is back.

Nothing well formed is refused: applied, flagged (would block, time adjusted, late, drawer closed, PIN checked on the device, person not confirmed) or parked (due already paid or voided, member removed). The owner and fees.adjust staff resolve flagged and parked items.

Unattended: `node postman/run-m24-offline.js`. Rebuild this file with: node postman/build-collection-m24-offline.js

item.name: The copy, with the open dues (fees.collect)

exec: let j = null; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
const get = (o, p) => p.split('.').filter(Boolean).reduce((a, k) => (a == null ? undefined : a[k]), o);
if (ok && j) { const v = get(j, 'stamp'); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('stamp', v); }
if (ok && j) { const v = get(j, 'serverTime'); if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') pm.collectionVariables.set('serverTime', v); }
pm.test("today, refreshed every 10 minutes", () => { pm.expect(j.refreshMinutes === 10 && j.maxHours === 24 && /^v1\.gso\./.test(j.stamp)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Rafiq may come in; Tanvir with a warning (expired, unpaid)", () => { pm.expect(j.members.find((m) => m.id === pm.variables.get('rafiqMember')).decision === 'allow' && j.members.find((m) => m.id === pm.variables.get('tanvirMember')).reasons.join() === 'expired,unpaid').to.eql(true); });
pm.test("the dues with what is still owed", () => { pm.expect(j.dues.find((d) => d.id === pm.variables.get('rafiqDue')).outstandingPoisha === 250000).to.eql(true); });
